objective: Reuse the shared When surface in M2 editing without losing exact canonical intervals or conflict safety.

context_delta.dg_01: Direct Calendar selection explicitly resizes endpoint dates; relative date input relocates by day delta; timed relative input preserves naive wall-minute duration; all-day plus explicit time becomes one hour.
context_delta.dg_02: Keep an exact temporal baseline in the GUI draft; passthrough baseline start/end on semantic equality; serialize only changed values through the existing one-TZID wall-time bridge; no core change.
context_delta.conflict: Review preserves the entire draft and its exact baseline with the fresh token; Use latest replaces both; neither choice writes.
context_delta.dirty: Compare composed exact temporal values against latest, including both endpoints and type/TZID semantics, rather than using action history.
